headline: No registered workflow produces what you asked for, so none is offered.

unavailable.label: “run CONDOR on it so I get communities”
unavailable.reason: CONDOR runs only on a regulator-gene (source-target-weight) network; building one first (OTTER, PANDA, PUMA) is a separate run the request does not name.

unavailable.label: “Save them in condor_gut/”
